Hi Melissa / NovaCorp AP team,

Thanks for working with us on timing. Attached is INV-20260901 for the April–June usage window. To help our Q3 close and minimize chargebacks, can you confirm you can do a staged remit as discussed on our call: 60% via ACH today (9/29) and remaining 40% on 10/07 via virtual card?

If ACH is not possible for the first tranche, we can accept a wire for the 60% and still accept the 40% on 10/07 by card. If you can send a short proof-of-funds email or a remittance screenshot once the first movement is initiated, that will let us release the service hold immediately.

Attachments: INV-20260901.pdf (PDF)

Next steps / ask:
- Please confirm which route you will use for the first 60% (ACH / wire / virtual card).
- If ACH, confirm originating bank and expected debit date.
- If wire, please share ETA and bank ref.
- If virtual card for either tranche, let us know the processor so our finance team can expect the transaction.

Appreciate the quick turn — we have a small dependency on this to keep the integration team green for the week.

Best,
